standard.summary: 从训练数据中划分一部分作为验证集，每 N 个 epoch 计算一次验证 loss。帮助检测过拟合。
standard.effect: validation_split=0.1 表示 10% 的数据用于验证。验证 loss 不下降而训练 loss 继续下降是过拟合的标志。
standard.whenToUse: 数据量充足（>100 张）时推荐开启。想监控过拟合时。
standard.avoidWhen: 数据极少（<30 张）时验证集太小统计不可靠。

standard_en.summary: Splits part of the training data off as a validation set and computes a validation loss every N epochs. It helps detect overfitting.
standard_en.effect: validation_split=0.1 means 10% of the data is used for validation. A validation loss that stops falling while the training loss keeps falling is the sign of overfitting.
standard_en.whenToUse: Recommended when there is plenty of data (>100 images). When you want to watch for overfitting.
standard_en.avoidWhen: With very little data (<30 images) the validation set is too small to be statistically reliable.

advanced.principle: 训练前按 validation_split 比例随机划分数据集。验证集不参与梯度更新，只用于计算 loss。validation_every_n_epochs 控制验证频率。validation_loss_only=True 时只计算 loss（不生成样本）。eval_data_dir 可以使用独立的验证数据集。
advanced.intervention: DataLoader 划分后，每 N epoch 在验证集上 forward 计算 loss。
advanced.expectedImpact: 提供过拟合的早期预警。不直接影响训练质量。
advanced.tradeoffs: validation_seed 控制划分的随机性。max_validation_steps 限制验证步数。

advanced_en.principle: Before training, the dataset is randomly split by the validation_split ratio. The validation set takes no part in gradient updates and is used only to compute loss. validation_every_n_epochs controls validation frequency. With validation_loss_only=True only the loss is computed (no samples generated). eval_data_dir can use a separate validation dataset.
advanced_en.intervention: After the DataLoader split, every N epochs a forward computes the loss on the validation set.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Provides early warning of overfitting. Does not directly affect training quality.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: validation_seed controls the split's randomness. max_validation_steps limits the number of validation steps.
